headline: Building permit fee changes, a $311,148.96 permitting software contract, and a $36,000 recycling grant.
summary: Other items include a home rule petition on unaccepted ways maintenance and four net metering credit sales agreements. Councilors also have requests on topics such as solid waste fees, The Loop, and GIC enrollment.
items: Assign a councilor and the chair to the Police Chief Search Committee
Reappoint Dominique Pierre Louis as constable
Finance report: Searles Estate expenses and revenues, city credit card limits, finance department org chart, School Department contract payments, school financial research

Councilor requests: Housing Authority trash fees, Police, Fire, and DPW buildings feasibility study, online roadmap for accepting unaccepted ways, Echo Lane sewer betterment fees, buildings audit, HHSI permit fees, solid waste tonnage fees, GIC transition, The Loop, barrel policies, solar radar speed signs grant, federal road safety grant
Vehicle-for-hire licenses for Monumental Black Car Services and Bhamra Corporation
Contract C-27-46 with Springbrook Software for $43,858.47
Contract C-27-47 with Vertosoft for a three-year permitting software service totaling $311,148.96
Four net metering credit sales agreements (C-27-48 to C-27-51)
Unfinished resolution TR-26-97: $36,000 recycling dividends grant
Unfinished resolution TR-26-98: $33,000 transfer from the Edwin J. Castle Fund
Unfinished resolution TR-26-100: home rule petition on unaccepted ways maintenance
New resolution TR-26-101: $10,998.16 FY2027 SAFE grant
New resolution TR-26-102: $4,200.00 FY2027 Senior SAFE grant
New resolution TR-26-103: $15,411.92 transfer from the Edwin J. Castle Fund
New ordinance TO-26-23: update building permit fees
Any other business for the good and welfare of the community
location: Great Hall, Searles Building, 3rd. Floor, 41 Pleasant Street, Methuen, MA 01844
